heroLead: Wyano is a small unincorporated community in southern Westmoreland County, in coal-and-gas country where mineral ownership has been layered for generations.
intro: Southern Westmoreland County was coal country long before it was gas country, and Wyano sits right in the middle of that overlap. If your family's mineral rights near Wyano trace back to a coal-era deed, there's a decent chance the mineral estate and the coal estate were handled separately from each other, which affects what exactly you own today.
We sort that out before we ever talk numbers, because getting it wrong helps nobody.

sections.heading: Coal, Then Gas, Sometimes Different Owners
paragraphs: It's common in this part of Westmoreland County for coal rights to have been sold off separately from oil and gas rights decades apart, meaning a single tract can have three different owners: surface, coal, and oil and gas. Confirming which category your interest falls into is the first step in any real evaluation.
We pull the full deed history near Wyano to make sure we're pricing the actual oil and gas interest you hold, not a coal right that looks similar on paper but isn't the same thing.

sections.heading: Small Community, Real Production
paragraphs: Wyano doesn't show up in Marcellus headlines, but southern Westmoreland County has seen consistent horizontal drilling activity tied into shared multi-well pads. Production from a Wyano-area unit can be steady even without the name recognition of the busier core counties further south.
We evaluate based on your unit's actual production data, which we pull independently rather than relying only on what's printed on your statement.

sections.heading: A Simple Process for Complicated Land
paragraphs: Once we confirm what you actually own, an offer, and a closing, usually moves faster than the title research that got us there. We handle the courthouse work so the complexity of a coal-and-gas deed history doesn't become your problem to solve.

faqs.question: How do I know if my rights near Wyano are oil and gas or coal?
faqs.answer: Your deed language and any severance documents at the Westmoreland County recorder of deeds will specify which estate you hold. We check this as part of every review.

faqs.question: Does coal mining history affect gas well drilling nearby?
faqs.answer: It can, since operators sometimes need to account for old mine works when planning well paths, but it doesn't change your ownership of the oil and gas estate itself.

faqs.question: Is Wyano within an active drilling unit?
faqs.answer: Southern Westmoreland County has ongoing horizontal Marcellus activity. We verify your specific unit and production history before making an offer.
